_doc: Tunable rules shared by every platform. Change numbers here, never hard-code them in app code. See docs/scoring.md.

letters._doc: Letters Line. Letters use the word-knowledge model (scoring block) with this prior; only Nandu's find rounds are scored (guess = 1/findChoices). Trace thresholds are fractions of the centreline and multiples of the pen width.

games._doc: Games tab. Cricket Words: one over = oversBalls words, a match = overs overs. Train Yard sorts letters into wagons; Kolam Trace traces taught letters without the demo.

onboarding._doc: First-run setup. exposurePriorScale multiplies each word's starting prior (homeFrequency) by how often he hears Tamil; it seeds progress entries with n = 0, so the scoring model itself is unchanged.

yard._doc: Wagon yard rewards: a new engine colour every tripsPerColour trips.
